title: DAO Preview
tagline: Making DAOs more inclusive by reducing the barriers to entry. Its fun!
description: DAOs should be more inclusive. One solution for lowering the barrier to contribution is to make information more accessible. Our project takes complicated on-chain data and turns it into a cute little "DAO preview" images you can paste anywhere!
how_its_made: We used existing subgraphs provided by Dao Haus to query info about daos, such as the treasure and stats.
